notes:
### Added

- A full-screen video player - controls that hide on their own and can be locked, playback speed, aspect modes (Crop, Stretch, 16:9, 18:9, 4:3, Original, Fit to screen), screenshots, rotation, play as audio, the queue, mute, and gestures to seek, set brightness and volume, double-tap to skip, hold to speed up and pinch to zoom.
- Videos resume where you left off, and Settings > Video holds the video player's preferences.
- Playing a video opens the video player from any screen, and closing it brings back what you were listening to.
- Arrange any collection by hand - playlists, Favorites, albums, artists, genres and folders - with Custom as a sort of its own and a choice of where new tracks go.
- A Sorting section in Settings > Content: where new tracks go in a custom order, which "Apply to" the sort sheet starts on, and Reset sorting.
- Exported playlists keep their order, sort and dates added, and importing one restores them.
- Favorite albums, artists, genres, folders and playlists, listed in Favorites above its tracks.
- Near the top of a list, the scroll button takes you to the playing track.

### Changed

- The app opens in your own font and colours from the very first frame.
- The library's shortcuts collapse as you scroll, as a detail screen's header does.
- A screen's buttons sit in one stack with the scroll button, above the player.

### Fixed

- Lyrics from SimpMusic show apostrophes and other symbols as they should.
- Tall bottom sheets no longer pull back under your finger as they are dragged, and a sheet's header stays in place while its content scrolls.
